subject: Portal steward rotation + CAIQ snapshot request
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Carmen Ruiz <carmen.ruiz@cloudhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Portal steward rotation + CAIQ snapshot request

Hi Carmen —

Quick context: CloudHealth will be our primary point of contact for the upcoming procurement review and your OneTrust profile is listed on the questionnaire tracker. We need to rotate the portal steward to align with your procurement team’s new owner and pull a CAIQ snapshot for the items we’re validating this week.

As an initial ask, can you: 
- Confirm who will be the delegated portal steward (name + email) for OneTrust today?
- Upload a CAIQ snapshot (exported answers) for the latest profile or share a link that we can download by EOD Friday (2027-05-14).
- Accept the attached delegation_matrix.csv so we can reflect the change in our inventory and scheduled evidence rotations.

Attachments: delegation_matrix.csv (CSV) — proposed owner rows filled; CAIQ_snapshot_v1.xlsx (empty template we’ll use if you prefer us to drop-in answers)

If you want, Kimberly and Priya are available to join a 20-min screen share to walk the portal handoff and verify the CAIQ mapping. Proposed windows: 2027-05-11 10:00–12:00 PT or 2027-05-12 14:00–16:00 PT.

Thanks — we want to avoid any drift in the profile ahead of the SOC 2 intake next month.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: delegation_matrix.csv (CSV)]
[Attachment: CAIQ_snapshot_v1.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Carmen Ruiz <carmen.ruiz@cloudhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, security@cloudhealth.com
Date: 2027-05-09T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Portal steward rotation + CAIQ snapshot request

Jonas — thanks for the heads-up.

Short answers up front:
- New steward: Luis Ortega <luis.ortega@cloudhealth.com> (will be primary portal owner going forward).
- CAIQ snapshot: Attached is an export from OneTrust as of this morning; file name CAIQ_export_20270509.xlsx. We've also published the live link (below) — permissions set to view for redwoodinference@cloudhealth.com.

I'll accept the proposed delegation matrix and update the owner column myself today (I made a few comments in column D where we have special-case controls for our environment).

If you still want a short walkthrough, Luis can join on 5/11 at 10:30 PT. Otherwise we can proceed with the update and I'll follow up once the owner is in place.

Attachments: CAIQ_export_20270509.xlsx

--
Carmen Ruiz
Senior Procurement Manager
CloudHealth Technologies
[Attachment: CAIQ_export_20270509.xlsx (XLSX)]

Subject: Re: Portal steward rotation + CAIQ snapshot request

Great, Carmen — really appreciate the quick turnaround.

Plan we’ll follow: 
1) Priya will ingest your CAIQ_export_20270509.xlsx into our tracker (ticket RF-4723) and mark the fields you commented as "special-case".
2) Kimberly will update the OneTrust owner field in our internal inventory to Luis Ortega and configure scheduled evidence checks to run on a 90-day cadence.
3) Jonas/Kimberly will only request a brief 20-min handoff if there’s anything ambiguous after ingestion; otherwise we’ll proceed and send a confirmation once the owner is reflected in the system.

Can you confirm Luis has view permission on the Onetrust claim link (redwoodinference@cloudhealth.com)? If not, Carmen — please add or Luis can confirm his access during the 5/11 10:30 PT slot.

Thanks again — will update you once ingestion completes.

—
Jonas
Senior Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
